$comment: Shared value definitions. Definition names are unique across every file in this directory because the generator merges all $defs into one namespace.

Id.description: Record identifier. The character set is the OpenAPI component-key set, so an id is usable as a JSON Pointer segment, a schema component name and a file-name stem without escaping.

QualifiedId.description: A record id, optionally prefixed by a published-contract id and a colon to reference a record inside a pinned published contract.

Name.description: Member name (property, parameter, column, alternative). The character set is the intersection of SQL, PowerShell, C# and TypeScript identifiers.

Alias.description: Accountable owner or authority, named by team or role alias, never by a person.

Text.description: Non-empty prose. An unknown value is recorded as an unknown record, never as an empty string.

ContractVersion.description: Contract version of a versioned record. Distinct from the model format version, the configuration version and the record revision.

Revision.description: Revision of an authored knowledge record; incremented when its meaning changes.

Hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) or of the exact bytes of a file.

Duration.description: ISO 8601 duration, for example PT30S or P7D.

RelativePath.description: Repository-relative path with forward slashes. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes and '..' segments are rejected.

estimate.description: True when the value is an estimate rather than a measurement.

Basis.description: Epistemic status of a claim. 'accepted' is honoured only when a trusted acceptance record covers the claim; the stored word alone grants nothing.

SourceRef.description: Identifies the document or artifact a claim comes from, and the revision or retrieval context that pins it.

locator.description: Section, line or anchor inside the source.

RecordRef.description: Typed reference to a model record. A property is referenced as '<typeId>.<propertyName>'; an element of a composite-keyed collection, such as an edge, by its key values joined with '|', for example '<from>|<to>|<kind>'.

TaskClass.description: Class of work whose prerequisites differ.

Maturity.description: Contract maturity, distinct from task phase and from deployment state.

CheckResult.description: Result of one executed check. NOT_APPLICABLE requires a recorded justification.

Dimension.description: Compatibility dimension a change is assessed in.

ConcernId.description: Identifier of an applicable design concern from the behavior profile, for example 'operation.idempotency'.

NotApplicable.description: Justified exclusion of an applicable concern for one record.

Signature.description: Detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the enclosing record with its 'signature' member removed.
